// ===== RESEARCH ORCHESTRATOR =====
// Plans all research tasks and generates search queries

const input = $input.first().json;
const niche = input.niche || input.data?.niche;
const chatId = input.chatId || input.data?.chatId;
const state = input.state || input.data?.state || {};

// Generate comprehensive search queries for the niche
const queries = [
  // Core niche queries
  niche,
  `${niche} tips`,
  `${niche} advice`,
  `${niche} for beginners`,
  `${niche} mistakes to avoid`,
  `how to ${niche}`,
  `${niche} motivation`,
  `${niche} inspiration`,
  
  // Social media specific
  `${niche} instagram`,
  `${niche} tiktok`,
  `${niche} reels`,
  `${niche} carousel`,
  `${niche} content ideas`,
  `${niche} viral content`,
  `${niche} trending`,
  
  // Psychology & Pain points
  `${niche} problems`,
  `${niche} struggles`,
  `${niche} challenges`,
  `${niche} questions people ask`,
  `${niche} FAQ`,
  `${niche} myths`,
  `${niche} truth about`,
  `${niche} what no one tells you`,
  
  // Hooks & CTAs
  `${niche} hooks`,
  `${niche} captions`,
  `${niche} call to action`,
  `${niche} engagement`,
  `${niche} hashtags`,
  
  // Competitors
  `${niche} influencers`,
  `${niche} top creators`,
  `${niche} best accounts`,
  `${niche} competitors`,
  
  // Trends
  `${niche} trends 2025`,
  `${niche} trends 2026`,
  `whats popular in ${niche}`,
  `${niche} going viral`,
  
  // Monetization
  `${niche} products to sell`,
  `${niche} digital products`,
  `${niche} how to make money`,
  `${niche} affiliate marketing`,
  `${niche} courses`,
  
  // Google PAA style
  `what is ${niche}`,
  `why ${niche} is important`,
  `best ${niche} strategies`,
  `${niche} step by step`,
  `${niche} guide`,
  `${niche} tutorial`,
  
  // Sub-niches (auto-expand)
  `${niche} sub niches`,
  `${niche} micro niches`,
  `${niche} related topics`,
  `${niche} categories`
];

// Platform-specific research tasks
const platforms = [
  { name: 'tiktok', searchUrl: `https://www.tiktok.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}` },
  { name: 'instagram', searchUrl: `https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/${encodeURIComponent(niche.replace(/\s+/g, ''))}/` },
  { name: 'reddit', searchUrl: `https://www.reddit.com/search/?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}&sort=top` },
  { name: 'youtube', searchUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${encodeURIComponent(niche + ' best content')}` },
  { name: 'pinterest', searchUrl: `https://www.pinterest.com/search/pins/?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}` },
  { name: 'twitter', searchUrl: `https://twitter.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}&src=typed_query&f=top` },
  { name: 'linkedin', searchUrl: `https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/content/?keywords=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}` },
  { name: 'google_trends', searchUrl: `https://trends.google.com/trends/explore?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}` },
  { name: 'google_paa', searchUrl: `https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(niche + ' people also ask')}` },
  { name: 'facebook_groups', searchUrl: `https://www.facebook.com/groups/search/groups/?query=${encodeURIComponent(niche)}` }
];

return [{
  json: {
    niche,
    chatId,
    queries,
    platforms,
    state,
    researchStartTime: new Date().toISOString()
  }
}];
